newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU approval of CLT/Bertelsmann link seen easier.
newsitem.headline: EU approval of CLT/Bertelsmann link seen easier.

text.p: European Competition Commissioner Karel van Miert said on Monday that the decision by CLT and Bertelsmann to abandon digital pay television plans would help the Commission's assessment of the merger between CLT and Bertelsmann's UFA.

Asked what the commission thought about news last week that CLT and Bertelsmann would drop the plans to launch a second digital pay television channel in Germany, he said: "It makes things easier because the most problematic aspect was pay television."
He was speaking on the sidelines of a seminar on competition organised by Brussels think-tank Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS).
The deal, which involved the merger of Luxembourg based CLT and UFA was submitted to the EU for clearance earlier this month. -- Brussels Newsroom ++ 32 2 287 6810
